hero.motto: My projects, from a school quiz to web apps and experiments with AI.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Web apps, AI experiments, and coursework. Open a project for screenshots and details.

vkoMonitoring.title: VKO Monitoring
vkoMonitoring.summary: An internet quality monitoring system for schools across East Kazakhstan.
vkoMonitoring.description: A distributed platform collects connection metrics from school computers and turns them into a clear network map, incident log, and reporting workspace for responsible teams.

highlights.scope: One dashboard for schools, devices, alerts, incidents, and analytical reports.
highlights.architecture: React client, Node.js API, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO, and a dedicated system agent with an offline SQLite queue.
highlights.result: Automated download, upload, ping, jitter, and packet-loss tests keep working through temporary outages.

aiMediaWatch.title: AI Media Watch
aiMediaWatch.summary: A multimodal system that detects fraudulent content in social media videos.
aiMediaWatch.description: The platform accepts links and video streams from several sources, extracts speech, text, and visual signals, then produces an explainable risk assessment for casino, pyramid, and crypto scams.

highlights.scope: Manual uploads, a link queue, Telegram bot, and browser extension feed one review registry.
highlights.architecture: React and Node.js coordinate a Python/FastAPI pipeline using Whisper, OCR, OpenCV, YOLO, and a local llama.cpp LLM.
highlights.result: Users receive a verdict, threat level, and evidence breakdown instead of an opaque model response.

myStrangeIdol.title: My Strange Idol
myStrangeIdol.summary: A platform for text and voice conversations with AI characters.
myStrangeIdol.description: The interactive service lets users discover real and fictional characters, role-play with them, return to conversation history, and hear generated responses through voice playback.

highlights.scope: Searchable tagged catalog, personal chats, message history, and voice mode.
highlights.architecture: React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, and Socket.IO extended with Ollama, Llama, and TTS.
highlights.result: A continuous character experience from discovery to long-form conversation with retained context.

eda.title: EDA: Student Performance
eda.summary: An exploration of how student lifestyle factors relate to academic performance.
eda.description: This Jupyter study covers the full exploratory workflow for a synthetic dataset of 1,000 students and 15 features: data quality, distributions, feature preparation, and relationships between habits and results.

highlights.scope: Sleep, attendance, physical activity, social media, diet, stress, and final grades.
highlights.architecture: Python, pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn in a reproducible Jupyter Notebook.
highlights.result: Prepared features, correlation analysis, and clear visualizations provide a base for further modeling.

airportSystem.title: Airport System
airportSystem.summary: An airport web system with a flight board, ticket purchase, and passenger check-in.
airportSystem.description: The project brings passenger journeys and administrative operations together: flight lookup, ticketing, registration, boarding-pass issuance, and role-based data management.

highlights.scope: Live flight board, passengers, tickets, check-in, boarding passes, and administrative roles.
highlights.architecture: React and Material UI on the client, with Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, and Sequelize on the server.
highlights.result: The main stages of passenger service are connected in one consistent digital flow.

mathematicalAnalysis.title: Mathematical Analysis
mathematicalAnalysis.summary: An interactive electronic guide to the foundations of mathematical analysis.
mathematicalAnalysis.description: This desktop learning navigator organizes theory into focused sections and helps learners move step by step through the key topics of mathematical analysis.

highlights.scope: Sets, complex numbers, numerical sequences, limits, function limits, and differentiation.
highlights.architecture: A standalone desktop application built with Clickteam Fusion Developer+.
highlights.result: Six learning sections are presented in an accessible interactive format with simple navigation.

cargoTransportation.title: Cargo Transportation
cargoTransportation.summary: A cargo booking and tracking system with route and delivery-cost calculation.
cargoTransportation.description: The logistics platform helps create orders, calculate delivery parameters, follow shipment status, and manage connected data through one web interface.

highlights.scope: Orders, routes, delivery costs, shipment statuses, and cargo tracking.
highlights.architecture: React, MobX, RSuite, and i18n on the client; Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, and JWT on the server.
highlights.result: Core logistics operations are combined into a clear bilingual workflow.

schoolProject.title: School Project
schoolProject.summary: A humorous computer-science quiz made as a gift for a school teacher.
schoolProject.description: This small standalone game combines pixel visuals, computer-science questions, and personal humor. It was created for graduation as a memorable interactive present.

highlights.scope: Themed questions, game screens and a custom visual style.
highlights.architecture: A standalone desktop application built in Clickteam Fusion Developer.
highlights.result: An early completed game experiment that turned a learning task into something personal.
